perturbation_free_baseline.control_purpose: Use a matched unperturbed frozen run if available.
perturbation_free_baseline.invalidation_condition: Unavailable unless a valid frozen matched unperturbed artifact exists.

phase_2_2_address_control.control_purpose: Preserve coarse spectral summaries while destroying stable address correspondence.
phase_2_2_address_control.implementation_provenance: deterministic address-summary prefix rotation; source artifacts unchanged
phase_2_2_address_control.invalidation_condition: Invalid if d_addr does not increase or spectral/invariant/temporal summaries shift substantially.

phase_2_2_causal_control.control_purpose: Preserve event counts and label frequencies while destroying influence ordering and causal dependencies.
phase_2_2_causal_control.implementation_provenance: deterministic causal-depth and compatibility perturbation inside causal_summary
phase_2_2_causal_control.invalidation_condition: Invalid if d_causal does not increase or non-causal metrics shift substantially.

phase_2_2_invariant_control.control_purpose: Preserve labels and marginal descriptor values while destroying invariant field relationships.
phase_2_2_invariant_control.implementation_provenance: deterministic field rotation within invariant_summary; no source artifacts modified
phase_2_2_invariant_control.invalidation_condition: Invalid if d_inv does not increase by the predeclared minimum or expected unaffected metrics shift beyond tolerance.

phase_2_2_spectral_control.control_purpose: Preserve graph size and density while destroying low-mode alignment.
phase_2_2_spectral_control.implementation_provenance: deterministic low-mode complement transform inside spectral_low_mode_summary only
phase_2_2_spectral_control.invalidation_condition: Invalid if d_spec does not increase or non-spectral components shift substantially.

phase_2_2_structural_control.control_purpose: Preserve node and edge counts while destroying recovered transition topology.
phase_2_2_structural_control.implementation_provenance: deterministic chain rotation preserving event multiset and count
phase_2_2_structural_control.invalidation_condition: Invalid if d_struct does not increase or invariant/spectral/causal metrics shift substantially.

phase_2_2_temporal_control.control_purpose: Preserve event-time marginals and counts while destroying sequence and transition structure.
phase_2_2_temporal_control.implementation_provenance: deterministic sequence reversal with original event-time multiset retained
phase_2_2_temporal_control.invalidation_condition: Invalid if temporal ordering survives or invariant/spectral summaries shift substantially.
